label: Stagger grid
desc: A grid of cells that ripple in from any origin with a distance-based stagger; click a cell to replay from there.
use: landing hero decoration, empty states, loading reveals

label: Line draw
desc: Draws SVG paths with a stroke-dashoffset animation when scrolled into view, with replay.

label: Shape morph
desc: Morphs between circle, star and heart by interpolating normalised point lists, on click or auto-cycle.
use: landing hero, success states, icon toggles

label: Motion path
desc: An element follows an SVG path with tangent rotation, a fading trail and a scrub slider.
use: progress journeys, publishing status, landing illustrations

label: Draggable spring
desc: Drag, flick and throw a card with momentum, edge bounce and optional snap grid; arrow keys nudge.
use: playful dashboard widgets, landing page toys, kanban-style pickers

label: Scroll timeline
desc: A four-step sequence (title, bar, counter, icon) driven by scroll position inside a scroll container.
use: landing feature storytelling, stats sections, onboarding

label: Timeline sequence
desc: A mini timeline orchestrator with play, pause, restart and scrub controls; accepts custom steps.
use: animated explainers, onboarding walkthroughs, dashboard intros
